name: Region 5 (HCN 1-0)
notes: Real observed HCN J=1-0 cube (88.6318473 GHz rest, Galactic, BUNIT K) distributed with the pyspeckit test suite; used to exercise the radio and sub-mm line fitters on real data. Not an AGN: it is a Galactic molecular region, so it validates the tools rather than extending the AGN sample. The 1-D spectrum was extracted with pipeline/extract_cube_spectrum.py --box 5.
